channel.title: AI Daily Watch: OpenAI
channel.description: GPT models, ChatGPT, the OpenAI API, Codex, Sora, partnerships, leadership and policy.

item.title: OpenAI expands partnership with Oracle to bring its apps to ChatGPT
item.description: OpenAI: OpenAI and Oracle are expanding their partnership to bring Oracle applications and data into ChatGPT and to develop new Oracle products and services powered by OpenAI. U.S. Oracle customers will also be able to purchase the OpenAI API, Codex, and ChatGPT Work through Oracle Marketplace, broadening the partnership’s enterprise and developer reach.

item.title: OpenAI and Fanatics launch AI-powered Shop the Look
item.description: OpenAI: Fanatics launched Shop the Look, an OpenAI-powered feature that recommends coordinated, in-stock merchandise to sports fans. OpenAI says its team and Fanatics used Codex to develop recommendation tools, and testing across roughly 30,000 MLB products produced 10% higher engagement than the previous experience.

item.title: OpenAI and Poland’s NASK partner on AI safety and security
item.description: OpenAI: OpenAI announced a partnership with Poland’s NASK focused on AI safety, security, and technical research. The collaboration is intended to strengthen safeguards and support a more resilient digital ecosystem; it was published before the monitoring start date.
